camel_example: aliyun imm UpdateProject --region cn-hangzhou --ServiceRole AliyunIMMDefaultRole --Description immtest --ProjectName 'test-project' --DatasetMaxBindCount 10 --DatasetMaxEntityCount 10000000000 --ProjectMaxDatasetCount 1000000000 --DatasetMaxTotalFileSize 90000000000000000 --DatasetMaxRelationCount 100000000000 --Tag '[{"Value":"TestValue","Key":"TestKey"}]' --DatasetMaxFileCount 100000000 --TemplateId 'Official:ImageManagement'
description_en: Updates the information of a created project
description_zh: 更新一个已创建项目（Project）的信息
kebab_example: aliyun imm update-project --project-name test-project --service-role AliyunIMMDefaultRole --description immtest --template-id Official:ImageManagement --project-max-dataset-count 1000000000 --dataset-max-bind-count 10 --dataset-max-file-count 100000000 --dataset-max-entity-count 10000000000 --dataset-max-relation-count 100000000000 --dataset-max-total-file-size 90000000000000000 --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateProject

parameters.help_en: The project name. For information about how to obtain the project name, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478153.html
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en:
The service role that grants Intelligent Media Management (IMM) permissions to access other cloud resources such as Object Storage Service (OSS).

To customize a service role, create a regular service role in the Resource Access Management (RAM) console and grant permissions to the role. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116800.html and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116147.html
parameters.help_zh:
服务角色，授权给IMM服务以访问其他云资源（例如OSS）的权限。

如果要自定义服务角色，您可以通过RAM控制台创建普通服务角色并为角色授权。具体操作，请分别参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116800.html和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116147.html
parameters.name: service_role

parameters.help_en: The project description. The description must be 1 to 256 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 项目描述信息。长度为1~256个英文或中文字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The workflow template ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/466304.html
parameters.help_zh: 工作流模板ID。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/466304.html
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of datasets in the project. Valid values: 1 to 1000000000
parameters.help_zh: 项目中数据集的最大个数。取值范围为1~1000000000
parameters.name: project_max_dataset_count

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of bindings for each dataset. Valid values: 1 to 10
parameters.help_zh: 每个数据集绑定的最大个数。取值范围为1~10
parameters.name: dataset_max_bind_count

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of files in each dataset. Valid values: 1 to 100000000
parameters.help_zh: 每个数据集中文件的最大个数。取值范围为1~100000000
parameters.name: dataset_max_file_count

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of metadata entities in each dataset.
This is a reserved parameter and is not enforced during use
parameters.help_zh:
每个数据集中元数据实体的最大个数。
预留参数，使用中并不做实际限制
parameters.name: dataset_max_entity_count

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of metadata relationships in each dataset.
This is a reserved parameter and is not enforced during use
parameters.help_zh:
每个数据集中元数据关系的最大个数。
预留参数，使用中并不做实际限制
parameters.name: dataset_max_relation_count

parameters.help_en: The maximum total file size in each dataset. After the limit is exceeded, no more indexes can be added. Unit: bytes
parameters.help_zh: 每个数据集中文件总大小的最大值，超过限制后无法再添加索引。单位为字节
parameters.name: dataset_max_total_file_size
